name: Crystal VFX Pack

frame_count_notes: Crystal v1: 23f; v2: 45f; v3: 20f; v4: 27f; v5: 46f; v6: 84f; v7: 38f; v8: 27f. Total: 310 frames across 8 animations. Plus 6 static crystals.
bundle_membership: VFX Collector Pack ($10.40, 35% off; all Fellor VFX packs)

extraction_notes: Crystal v6 has 84 frames — notably high for this vendor's tier, suggesting at least one cinematic-quality animation. Crystal v2 (45f) and v5 (46f) also substantial. Frames are dense relative to pack count. Novel substrate anchor for this vendor.
